_comment: Synthetic VIOLATION (undecidable horizon): a fresh grant (1700003600, +3600s) but a presented token whose TTL is 0 (non-positive) — it names no real horizon, so the ttl-vs-now verdict is undecidable. The check must FAIL with inject-class-ttl-horizon-undecidable, not mask it as a routine expiry (a 0 TTL would otherwise satisfy ttl <= now and read as merely lapsed).
